d: Deep espresso brown hair is styled into a high, voluminous ponytail with long, flowing strands and uneven bangs framing a youthful, mature face. Sharp, almond-shaped eyes glow with a vivid azure blue hue. The slender build is adorned in a white and teal bikini-style top, accented by a brown geometric tattoo on the right upper arm. A gold hair pin secures the ponytail.
